# User rules (Claude Code / Codex)

**Generated; do not edit.** Edit `rules/manifest.json`, `BASE.md` (`BASE.mdc` is generated from it), or the `.mdc` / `agents.d/` body a section names, then run `bin/generate-agents-md.py --apply`. `~/.claude/rules` links to the generated `rules/claude/` (Claude reads that folder, not this file).
